title: tococa symphyandra
intro: Tococa symphyandra, commonly known as the Amazonian cup plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ochnaceae. This plant is known for its unique, cup-like structure that contains a toxic latex, which is used for medicinal purposes. The health benefits of Tococa symphyandra include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Tococa symphyandra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activity.
